stable.notes: Every agent row now carries its platform's mark, so you can tell Claude from Codex from Cursor at a glance instead of reading the label: a spark for Claude, a terminal prompt for Codex, a cube for Cursor, and a chip for a local model, each in that platform's colour. Live rows, idle rows and finished entries all draw from one shared mark, so a platform can never look like one thing in the list and another in the chips. Pairs with server 6.41.0.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
